We make horror games. Free, and each one whole on its own.

Small, finished games about something too large to hold, told with light, sound and distance instead of gore. They are separate stories in the same country; none of them continues another.

The games

File 01 · Recovered build

VOID//DRIFT

A build recovered from a device none of the team owned. You thread the gaps and the log fills as you go, in the words of the people who were there. In the second photograph the treeline is closer. Nobody moved the camera. Nothing followed them out.

Run it

File 02 · Site recovery

RECOVERED RECORDS

A site nobody has walked since. A table set for four, one plate untouched. A door latched from this side. A family photograph with a gap where a face should be. Listening costs you, and so does looking, and neither comes back. You cannot leave until you understand what happened here.

Walk it

File 03 · Signal

TRANSCRIPT

A dead band, and something tuning through it the same way, at the same intervals. It is not music. It is a sentence, struck one mark at a time, and every mark you land teaches it your timing. The gap in the tape is not missing. It is the part that is listening.
